name: meditate-guidance
description: Guide a person through a meditation session from preparation through closing. AI coaches posture selection, breath anchoring, working with distractions, shamatha (calm abiding), vipassana (insight), and session integration. Use when a person wants to begin or deepen a meditation practice, when someone needs to prepare their mind for focused work, when grounding is needed before or after energy healing work, when managing stress or anxiety, or for integration after intense experiences.
